units.unit_title_en: Unit 1: The Number System and Real Numbers
units.unit_title_am: ምዕራፍ 1: የቁጥር ስርዓት እና እውነተኛ ቁጥሮች
units.unit_title_om: Boqonnaa 1: Sirna Lakkoofsaa fi Lakkoofsota Dhugaa
units.instructional_summary: Master properties of rational and irrational numbers, radical operations, and scientific notations.
core_competencies: Demonstrate conceptual mastery of the number system and real numbers.
Solve representative Ethiopian national examination problems on the number system and real numbers.
Relate theoretical models to practical industrial, biological, or technological situations.

core_competencies_om: Hubannoo yaadaa Sirna Lakkoofsaa fi Lakkoofsota Dhugaa agarsiisuu.
Gaaffilee qormaata biyyoolessaa Itoophiyaa Sirna Lakkoofsaa fi Lakkoofsota Dhugaa irratti hundaa'an furuu.
Moodeelota tiyoorii qabatama jireenyaa waliin wal-qabsiisuu.
